name: vision
description: Bounded image and PDF recognition through SiliconFlow Qwen3-VL with clipboard support, page batching, and usage telemetry

capabilities.name: vision.image_recognize
capabilities.description: Recognize supported image formats through a bounded multimodal request

capabilities.name: vision.pdf_recognize
capabilities.description: Render bounded PDF pages, batch recognition requests, and return page-aware output

capabilities.name: vision.clipboard
capabilities.description: Read an explicitly requested clipboard image and pass it through the recognition pipeline

credentials.description: Credential for the SiliconFlow Qwen3-VL recognition endpoint

health_checks.description: Verify image/PDF recognition and clipboard adapters import

storage.description: Local request usage telemetry without credential values
Rendered PDF pages use bounded temporary files and are deleted after processing
